visualCharacteristics.purpose: Hub page entry points: full-width tiles linking to category detail pages (e.g. Solutions by Market / Role / Requirement)
visualCharacteristics.layout: One tile per row, stacked with a small gap; from 900px a dark grey text area on the left (~70%) with white heading and description and the photo on the right (~30%); below 900px the photo sits above the text. The whole tile is clickable
visualCharacteristics.sourceSection: Solutions Hub Tiles (solutions.html), set on a light-grey section

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: cell 1 tile image; cell 2 heading linked to the detail page, description paragraph. The heading link (or the first link in the tile) becomes the whole-tile link

usage: Hub or landing pages that route visitors to a few category pages with a short description each.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width horizontal link tiles (text beside image). For a 3-up image-top card grid with a 'Go Now' CTA use cards-solutions; for icon + label quick links use cards-icon-links.
